icons.source: scripts/extract_card_icons.py, harvested from the 54 card fronts already in public/cards/ -- nothing uploaded, nothing fetched. plantdex.online is proxy-blocked from this sandbox and did not need to be reached.
icons.how_labelled: Each front carries exactly two discs in two fixed slots, and herbs.json lists that card's two uses IN ORDER. Labels come from that cross-reference, not from somebody deciding what a picture means -- then every instance is re-classified against the medoids to check the ordering assumption actually holds.
icons.agreement: 85/90 use discs and 45/45 season tiles land on their own label. The five that do not all involve topical/bone/wound/energy, which are genuinely similar at the 48px grey resolution the check compares at. All twelve were then verified BY EYE against the rendered set and every label is correct: bone=joint, calm=seated figure, digestive=stomach, edible=fork and knife, energy=bolt, heart=heart with pulse, immune=shield, lungs=lungs, tea=steaming cup, topical=open hand, urinary=kidneys, wound=bandage.

review_flags.reason: ALL FIVE EMBEDDED FONTS ARE SUBSETTED to Pine #41's own glyphs. The cmap still lists 700-1400 entries, so counting it reports them complete -- my first check did that and passed. Rendering each glyph shows the outlines are empty: Baloo 65 blank, Palatino-BoldItalic 61, Palatino-Bold 42 (every digit), Avenir-Medium 34. Ten strings are therefore NOT PAINTED. The renderer refuses rather than printing gaps. Needs the full Palatino Bold Italic, Palatino Bold, Avenir Medium and Baloo Bhaijaan v1.

Baloo Bhaijaan 2 is free, downloads cleanly and renders completely. NOT USED: it is a later redesign with different letterforms, and substituting visually similar type was ruled out. Approve it, or send the v1 cut.
No sourced water/sun/temperature values. The icons and the exact slots are ready; the rows are left empty rather than assigned.
No sourced value. GBIF occurrence counts are the obvious basis; mapping a count to Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic is a product decision not yet made.

All four season icons exist. The eight CC0 observations run April to September across Spain, Italy, Hungary, Russia and the UK -- too few and too scattered to call a season. Eight photos are not phenology.
A taste note is an observation by somebody holding the plant, not a citation.
One claim refused: the sesquiterpenoid list was drafted at laboratory standing but its source sits in the documented-use query group, which can only support traditional.
